source_evidence: For accepted orders the warehouse picks the parts, packs the order and books a carrier.
problem: The warehouse department is marked as an automated authority instead of a human organisational performer.
correction: Change Lane_warehouse laneMeta authority from "authority" to "sovereignty".

source_evidence:
The warehouse also does quality inspection and labelling for each order, but nobody could
say whether those happen before or after packing, or in which order relative to each other.

map_evidence.quote: <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="pick-parts--quality-inspection" sourceRef="pick-parts" targetRef="quality-inspection" /><bpmn:sequenceFlow id="quality-inspection--pack-order" sourceRef="quality-inspection" targetRef="pack-order" />

problem: The map fixes quality inspection between picking and packing even though its position is explicitly unknown.
correction: Remove both sequence flows through quality-inspection and their incoming/outgoing references, restore a direct pick-parts to pack-order flow, and leave quality-inspection unconnected with an associated note declaring its unknown order relative to packing and labelling.

map_evidence.quote: <bpmn:task id="send-payment-reminder" name="Send payment reminder"><bpmn:documentation>source: "The ERP sends a payment reminder after seven days."</bpmn:documentation>

problem: The map adds an ERP payment-reminder step with a fabricated source quotation that is absent from the interview notes.
correction: Remove send-payment-reminder, its documentation, lane reference and incident flows; connect generate-and-send-invoice directly to accepted-order-fulfilled and update the incoming/outgoing references.
